{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: What was total revenue by quarter in 2024?", "sql": "SELECT strftime('%Y', invoice_date) || '-Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', invoice_date) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter,
       SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM invoices
WHERE status = 'paid'
  AND invoice_date >= '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter"}
